title: Agentic payments
rationale: For an agent that can move money or commit to spend. Every check must be observed at runtime and signed by an independent key, evidence and assessments go stale within an hour, a named accountable party is required, and authority, budget and idempotence checks are hard floors.
limits: A starting point, not a validated threshold: no data shows these numbers predict real-world safety.
No template makes an agent safe. A qualified result is a local policy outcome, not an authorization grant.
Only evidence from source runtime can count; fixture and declaration evidence never satisfies these templates.
Signatures show key possession and byte integrity, not truthful execution, human identity or independent review.
Does not model fraud, legal liability, regulatory duties or payment-network rules.
Core checks are synthetic scenarios; they do not exercise a real payment rail.
Needs at least one trust key with role independent.
